variants.briefing:
You been doing good work for us, so I got a favor to ask. I'll still pay you, but it's a favor. Got some cargo that needs to get bounced from [Location] to [Destination] and the guy that was supposed to do it found himself on the wrong side of an airlock, but hey, shit still needs to get done.

Only thing is you'll need a ship that can carry [MissionMaxSCUSize] cargo containers.  A handheld tractor beam would also be smart to bring along. 

If you could sort it out for me, that'd be great.

- Stows out
